caption:
Lulu carries all the shopping in one hand up the apartment stairs, and her back aches every time.

When the load sits on one side, your body leans and your back can end up working lopsided. Splitting the bags between both hands and keeping them close can ease that.

Hybi's carry tips: split the bags between both hands, make two trips when the shop is heavy, try a backpack, and pause on the landings.

Pain spreading down a leg, numbness or weakness is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio
